spec.errorUnorderedSet: UNORDERED_SET cannot be used when the return type is a binary tree or a linked list. Change the matching strategy or the return type.
spec.signatureSubtitle: Declared once for all three languages. The harness maps the types to each language and generates the starter code: the learner writes only the function body, the harness reads the input and prints the output. Parameter names show up in the starter code and when a sample testcase is displayed.
spec.stubTitle: Starter code the learner will see
spec.stubSubtitle: Illustrated from the signature above; the real starter code is generated by the harness. The name is derived: Python uses snake_case, Java and C++ camelCase.
